description: Estaciones de bicicletas is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ayuntamiento de Santander. This dataset provides general information about the different bicycle stations in Santander City Council. Coverage: Ayuntamiento de Santander. The portal shows the English title as "Bicycle stations" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ayuntamiento de Santander. Its keywords include Tusbic, Bicicletas, Reutilización, Transporte. The listing shows 6 download or service links in JSON, TURTLE, XML, CSV. The listing shows 2015-09-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.es). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
